messages:
tara: quick sync \, we need to finalize the PRD acceptance checklist for the new API variant-slicing approach today. scope covers chat/completions, embeddings, rerank. can we nominate owners and call out launch gating?
jamal: i9ll own chat/completions. proposed slices: basic (single-turn), convo-state (KV cache resume), streaming. acceptance bullets: latency SLOs per slice, streaming gap tolerance <200ms, token-cost budget per 1k tokens.
alex: embeddings owner here. slices: small-embed (512d), medium-embed (1536d), dense-quant (8-bit). acceptance: recall thresholds (medium > 0.88), embedding_dim returned in responses, clear backward-compatible id for upserts.
ben: rerank owner. slices: score-only (fast), score+explain (optional reasons), fallback variant (model-A) when overloaded. acceptance: rerank A/B lift >=5% on benchmark, deterministic tie-breaking, p95 latency <120ms for score-only.
cindy: product constraints: customers requested per-request slice override and customer-level pinning for controlled rollouts. add client_pin to contract. also pricing note: pricing tied to slice family not per-variant to keep simple.
tara: agreed on client_pin. avoid exploding pricing model. include canary plan in PRD.
jamal: edge cases to document: truncated KV on resume, client-provided older model_version in metadata, streaming disconnects -> regenerate tail. add tests for these.
alex: embeddings edge cases: dimensionality mismatch on upsert, quantized vs float read paths, partial reindex for cold-start. add nightly regression checks.
ben: rerank edge cases: ties across variants (stable ordering required), incompatible feature vectors -> fallback to lexical scoring, overloaded GPU -> degrade to CPU endpoint and tag traces.
tara: draft launch criteria: 1) core acceptance pass per slice, 2) E2E smoke tests for main clients, 3) canary to 5% traffic with rollback policy, 4) telemetry: tokens, p95 latency, rerank delta, nightly eval regressions.
cindy: security/compliance: embeddings must not persist PII by default. customer opt-in for storing embeddings and KMS for private storage. include in acceptance.
jamal: API example for chat: 
```
POST /v1/responses
{ "model": "redwood-chat-v1", "slice": "convo-state", "client_pin": "team-123", "input": "..." }
```
streaming with cursor for resume.
ben: rerank API example: 
```
POST /v1/rerank
{ "model": "rerank-v2", "slice": "score-only", "items": [{"id":"a","doc":"..."}], "trace_id": "xyz" }
```
response: [{"id":"a","score":0.72, "reason":null}]

tara: keep reason nullable on default path. explain slice will populate reasons. add observability: per-request slice tag + sampling when explain enabled.
alex: embeddings acceptance add: nightly eval regression alert if mean cosine drop > 0.03 vs baseline. API returns `embedding_dim` for client validation. query p95 for medium slice <=40ms after indexing.
cindy: rollout timeline: week 1 internal + partners canary; week 2 self-serve with throttles; week 3 fully open. Dedicated SLA gating only after 4 weeks post-open.
jamal: test matrix i'll author: smoke, convo resume (5-step), streaming reconnect, cold KV cache hit-rate, cost per 1k tokens by slice.
ben: rerank test matrix: deterministic tie-breaker check, throughput 2k QPS for score-only, failure injection to ensure fallback and trace tagging.
tara: action items: jamal -> chat slice acceptance + tests by Tue; alex -> embeddings acceptance + eval thresholds by Tue; ben -> rerank acceptance + benchmark plan by Wed; cindy -> rollout + pricing note; i9ll collate PRD and start API contract doc.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window 2025-03-05 02:00 UTC (hold until PRD approved) :warning:
cindy: add explainability opt-in for legal/regulatory reasons and UI notes. make explicit in acceptance criteria and in rollout doc.
tara: agreed. require sampling for full reasons to control cost and privacy.
jamal: will include spans: `span.slice` and `span.kv_hit:true/false` in tracing spec.
alex: storage note: dense-quant indexing async. acceptance: query-time p95 for medium slice <=40ms after indexing completes.
tara: if anyone misses Tue/Wed deliverables call it out now.
ben: i need access to latest rerank harness @cindy
cindy: granted, invited to repo.
tara: thanks. i'll update the PRD draft tonight and post link here for review before Friday standup. :thumbsup:
